title: Teams
description: Manage team members, shared quotas, and permissions
team_id_description: ID of the team you want to create. If not provided, it will be generated automatically.
models_hint: These are the models that your selected team has access to. Leave empty to grant no models directly, e.g. when the team gets its models from access groups
metadata_description: Values are saved as text. Enter JSON for typed values, e.g. 3, true, or {"region": "us"}.
team_member_budget_hint: This is the individual budget for a user in the team.
model_scope_tooltip: Models this member can access. Empty means they inherit all team models.
current_cycle_spend_tooltip: Spend for the current budget cycle. Resets to $0 when the member's budget window rolls over. This is the value checked against the member's budget.
total_spend_tooltip: Cumulative spend by this member within this team, across all budget cycles. Tracking began 2026-04-21; spend from before that date is not included.
team_member_rate_limits_tooltip: Rate limits for this member's usage within this team.
team_role_tooltip: This role applies only to this team and is independent from the user's proxy-level role.
subtitle: Manage teams, members, and their access to models and budgets
delete_team_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to delete this team, all its keys, and any models created for it? This action cannot be undone.
delete_team_keys_warning: Warning: This team has {{count}} keys associated with it. Deleting the team will also delete all associated keys, along with any models created for this team. This action is irreversible.
org_hint_hierarchy: Organizations can have multiple teams. Learn more about the user management hierarchy
only_create_teams_within_org: You can only create teams within this organization
select_enter_guardrails: Select existing guardrails or enter new ones
disable_global_guardrails_hint: When enabled, this team will bypass any guardrails configured to run on every request (global guardrails)
bypass_global_guardrails_desc: Bypass global guardrails for this team
premium_bypass_guardrails_desc: Premium feature - Upgrade to disable global guardrails by team
policies_hint: Apply policies to this team to control guardrails and other settings
select_enter_policies: Select existing policies or enter new ones
access_groups_hint: Assign access groups to this team. Access groups control which models, MCP servers, and agents this team can use
select_access_groups_desc: Select access groups to assign to this team
object_permissions_desc: Access control for Vector Stores and MCP Servers
no_restriction_search_tools: No restriction — all configured search tools are allowed for this team.
no_private_skills_desc: No private skills granted. Only enabled (public) Claude Code plugins are visible.
no_agents_configured: No agents or access groups configured

logging.disabled_callbacks_tooltip: Select callbacks to disable for this key. Disabled callbacks will not receive any logging data.
logging.disabled_callbacks_desc: Select callbacks that should be disabled for this key. These callbacks will not receive any logging data.
logging.logging_integrations_tooltip: Configure callback logging integrations for this team.
logging.no_integrations_desc: Click "Add Integration" to configure logging for this team

available_teams.docs_hint: See how to set available teams

virtual_keys_table.search_placeholder: Search by key alias or ID…
virtual_keys_table.no_model_access_tooltip: Scoped to {{label}} routes; this key cannot call any models

permissions.title: Member Permissions
permissions.description: Control what team members can do when they are not team admins.

my_user.error: Failed to load your membership info for this team.
my_user.no_data: No membership info available for the current user in this team.
my_user.current_cycle_spend_tooltip: Spend for the current budget cycle. Resets to $0 when the budget window rolls over.
my_user.rate_limits_tooltip: Your per-member rate limits within this team.
my_user.total_spend_tooltip: Cumulative spend across all budget cycles within this team.
my_user.model_scope_tooltip: Models you can access within this team.

budget_reset_period_desc: How often this member's budget resets within the team. Leave unset and the budget never resets.
team_member_budget_desc: Maximum amount in USD this member can spend within this team. This is separate from any global user budget limits
team_member_budget_placeholder: Budget limit for this member within this team
team_member_tpm_limit_desc: Maximum tokens per minute this member can use within this team. This is separate from any global user TPM limit
team_member_tpm_limit_placeholder: Tokens per minute limit for this member in this team
team_member_rpm_limit_desc: Maximum requests per minute this member can make within this team. This is separate from any global user RPM limit
team_member_rpm_limit_placeholder: Requests per minute limit for this member in this team
allowed_models_member_desc: Models this member can access within this team. Leave empty to inherit all team models.
allowed_models_member_placeholder: Leave empty to inherit all team models
